holder-quote: The answer was obvious and Eska’s hesitation clear as the second tribe appeared over the hill they were descending, as the ground leveled out and became the Great Plains, so reminiscent of her homeland for their flat, enormous landscapes. But the Great Plains were many times larger than her entire homeland, Inkar had learned.
The Gnoll gave Eska a blank look.
Eska was a [Chieftain of Herds], more comfortable managing animals
